source_reference.scope: format/algorithm/result correspondence, not corresponding Samsung source

interpretation.verifier: 0x1262b0 receives data X0, length X1, optional key pointer X2 and key length X3 outputs
interpretation.header: 256-byte minimum; AVB0 comparison; host-order conversion 0x125b48 is an opaque callee in this report
interpretation.version: selected host-order major equals 1 and minor <= 1, otherwise result 3
interpretation.bounds: local alignment, overflow and range checks precede crypto; not a complete memory-safety proof
interpretation.hashed_bytes: original 256-byte header followed by the entire auxiliary block; excludes authentication block
interpretation.hash_result: computed digest compared to authentication-block hash; mismatch returns 4
interpretation.rsa_inputs: key in auxiliary block, signature and hash in authentication block; padding from algorithm table
interpretation.rsa_result: false from 0x126b30 returns 5; true publishes optional key outputs then returns 0
interpretation.rsa_checks: supported serialized key bit counts 2048/4096/8192, exact key/signature lengths, padding and digest comparisons
interpretation.rsa_exponent: Montgomery conversion, eight pairs of squarings, final multiplication; corresponds to exponent 65537
interpretation.slot_result_0: requires nonzero key pointer and length before selected normal continuation
interpretation.slot_results_1_4_5: sets slot result 3; frame+248 decides cleanup versus continued processing with retained error
interpretation.trust: crypto success is followed by separate key trust and remaining slot checks
